baseline.meaning: 100 = average 4-week total in 2024-25 ('recent normal', not a long-run average)

components.ADM_TO_CVL: Administrations moving to CVL (excluded from CVL)
components.MEMO_REC: Receiver appointments (memo, not legally required to be gazetted)
components.MEMO_DIS: Disclaimers (memo, not legally required to be gazetted)

rules.unit: One event per company per procedure (company number from the notice; company name where no number is shown). Repeat notices for the same company within 365 days (120 for CVLs, 180 for petitions) are not counted again.
rules.date_basis: Week (Monday start) in which the first notice for the event was published in The Gazette. The free feed does not expose the appointment or order date.
rules.cvl: Counted from liquidator appointment notices (2443), plus resolution notices (2441) only where they show a company number, one event per company. Companies with an administration in the previous 18 months are counted separately as administration-to-CVL moves, not as new CVLs.
rules.petitions: Separate indicator from 4 April 2022, after Covid restrictions ended. The HMRC share of petitions is published only if HMRC can be detected in the free feed; at present the notice summary is truncated before the petitioner in most notices, so it is not shown.
rules.small_numbers: Regional figures use 13-week totals; cells with fewer than 20 events are not shown.
rules.weights: Each headline component weighted by 1 / (standard deviation of its 13-week log change during 2024-25), normalised to sum to 1 (Conference Board method).
rules.holidays: Weeks whose four-week window includes Christmas/New Year (24 Dec - 14 Jan, allowing for the slow restart) or the Easter bank holidays are flagged holiday_affected: far fewer notices are published then, so the index dips for calendar reasons. Compare those weeks with the same weeks a year earlier. The index is not yet seasonally adjusted.
rules.restricted_period: Winding-up petitions were restricted by law from spring 2020 to 31 March 2022 (Corporate Insolvency and Governance Act 2020 and follow-on regulations).
